menuNotes.RollCallMenu: attendance-roll-call: the day's register of one group. A group teacher lands on their own group and today; coordinators and administration-managers pick any group. The server (RollCallService) decides who may open which group, so the gate here only decides who sees the entry.
menuNotes.AbsenceReportsMenu: The absence reports guardians and the school file (ExcuseRequest). The list reads only what the register lets the user read: a group teacher sees the reports of their own groups (teacherIds), coordinators and directors the whole school. hr is left out because ExcuseRequest does not grant it. Compliance officers can read the reports too, but GroupPeople does not reach them, so AbsenceReportsComplianceMenu gives them the same page under Compliance. School-only, like the AttendanceFlags report card.

pages.title: Sign-up requests
pages._note: Aanmeldverzoeken (learniq/LqTlAanmeldverzoeken): the self sign-ups for a course on request. Two quick filters with their counts, 'Waiting for a decision' (pending, the default) and 'All sign-ups'; each pending row's Actions menu approves it (transition approve) or rejects it with a reason (DeclineSignUpDialog, transition decline). Who may decide is the Enrolment update rule (instructors, hr, compliance officers, team leads, and the learner's manager on a pending self sign-up); the server refuses anyone else.

pages.title: Enrolment
pages._note: An Enrolment links one learner to one course (learnerId, courseId, cohortId, mandatory flag, dueDate, source, manager, regulation) — the education enrolment/participation archetype. Body leads with enrolment metadata 8-wide with a Related panel resolving learner + course + cohort. The enrolment's academic footprint is surfaced as related-index tables filtered by learnerId + courseId: Grade entries, Submissions and Attendance records — the progress a coordinator checks on this enrolment. No email/calendar: the Enrolment schema declares no linkedTypes; learner correspondence belongs on the Learner profile, not on a join record (HARD RULE 1). Sidebar keeps metadata + audit-trail (enrolment source/mandate changes are compliance-relevant).

pages.title: Credential
pages._note: A Credential is an issued certificate/badge (learner, course, kind, issued/expires, issuer DID, signature, OpenBadges3 + EDCI payloads, verification URL, revocation reason) — the education document/attestation archetype. Body leads with issuance metadata 8-wide + a Related panel resolving learner + course + issuing enrolment. The signed badge artefacts render as a Files leaf (a credential IS a downloadable/verifiable document). No email/calendar: a credential is a sealed award, not correspondence (HARD RULE 1). Sidebar keeps metadata + audit-trail — issuance and revocation events are the credential's legal record.

pages.title: Verify Credential
pages._note: Public verification view of a Credential (mode:public) — a third party checking authenticity, NOT an internal editor. Deliberately minimal: a single full-width Data block showing only the verifiable claims (kind, learner, course, issued/expires, issuer DID, revocation status) plus a Files leaf for the signed badge artefact. No related-index, no comms, no audit sidebar — a public verifier must see the assertion and its signature and nothing about internal relations or history (HARD RULE 1, minimal-surface). Sidebar disabled: this is an anonymous proof page.

pages.title: Staff
pages._note: A Staff record is reference data (ncUserId, roles, qualifications, workingDays) with no lifecycle, same shape as Room. Body leads with the staff data 8-wide with a Related panel resolving Cohorts and SubjectTeacherAssignments this person is named on. No email/calendar/files (HARD RULE 1: reference data, not correspondence). Sidebar keeps metadata + audit-trail.

pages.title: School
pages._note: A School is a reference-data record (BRIN, name, pedagogical concept) with no lifecycle — same shape as Room. Body leads with the school data 8-wide with a Related panel resolving its Locations. No email/calendar/files (HARD RULE 1: reference data, not a document or correspondence archetype). Sidebar keeps metadata + audit-trail.

pages.title: Location
pages._note: A Location is a vestiging/onderwijslocatie reference-data record (schoolId, vestigingscode, onderwijslocatiecode, address) with no lifecycle — same shape as Room. Body leads with the location data 8-wide with a Related panel resolving its School and the Cohorts running there. No email/calendar/files (HARD RULE 1). Sidebar keeps metadata + audit-trail.

pages.title: Today's register
pages._note: Mounts RollCallView (attendance-roll-call): one screen per group and day, everyone present by default, one tap per exception, saved through /api/attendance/roll-call.

config._note: An Excuse Request is an absence justification (date range, reason kind, attachment, submitter auth level, decision) — a request/case archetype. Body leads with the request data including reason and decision (8-wide), a Related panel resolving learner and submitter, and the supporting attachment as a wide Files leaf (the evidence). Attendance records covered by this excuse render as a related-index. No comms leaves (no linkedTypes). Sidebar keeps metadata + audit-trail.
Board LqVerzuimgrens (G2): figures (limit, window, learners above it), the rule as a card, the signals it raised as a tab, and the statutory limit beside an own limit.

fields.text: The statutory rule of 16 hours keeps applying alongside: at 16 lesson hours missed without permission in 4 weeks a report goes to the Verzuimloket.

pages.title: People
pages._note: nav-restructure-dashboards: GroupPeople's navigable landing dashboard — a bespoke domain overview with no generic index/detail/dashboard analogue. The nav icon + group association live on the GroupPeople menu entry (base manifest + this fragment's menu route), not on the page (icon/group are not valid v2 page props).
